# Load Packages

Below you can find the list of packages that are required for all analysis steps. 

```{r, echo = F}
# genral packages
library(qvalue)
library(data.table)
library(tidyr)
library(rtracklayer)

# Packages for pathway enrichment
library(GSEABase)   # to load or generate gene set data
library(mgsa)  # load MGSA: a pathway enrichment analysis tool

# Packages for plotting
library(ggplot2)
library(VennDiagram)
library(viridis)  # color blind color palette
```


# Functions

To reduce code, we will generate some functions here. 

```{r definition, echo=F}
# function, which first generates the contingency table for two datasets and then calculates the p-value using fisher exact test
# return: the p-value calculated using fisher exact test
FishersExactTest <- function(data1, data2, background){
  data1  <- unique(sort(unlist(data1)))
  data2 <- intersect(data2, background)  # take only the genes, which are also in the background data
  a <- length(intersect(data1, data2))  # all genes in data1 and data2
  b <- length(data1) - a  # all genes in data1, but NOT in data2
  x <- length(setdiff(data2, data1))  # all genes in data2, but NOT data1
  y <- length(background) - length(data1) - x  # all genes NOT in data1 or data2
  contingency_matrix <- matrix(c(a, x, b, y), 2, 2)
  #print(contingency_matrix)
  result <- fisher.test(contingency_matrix, alternative = "greater")
  return(result$p.value)
}
```


# Age DEGenes

## Load data

First, we need to load the gene-based (gDEGenes), transcript-based (tDEGenes) and exon-based (eDEGenes) differentially expressed genes for age. Then, we filter the data for only significant (FDR < 10%) genes. 

```{r}
# gene-level
gDEGenes_age <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.1_diff_expr_genes_for_age.csv", select = c("Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), data.table = F)
bck_gDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(gDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
gDEGenes_age <- gDEGenes_age[gDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]

# transcript-level
tDEGenes_age <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", select = c("FDR estimate", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID"), data.table = F)
bck_tDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(tDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
tDEGenes_age <- tDEGenes_age[tDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]

# exon-level
eDEGenes_age <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_age_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", select = c("FDR estimate", "Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID"), data.table = F)
bck_eDEGenes_age <- unique(sort(eDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`))
eDEGenes_age <- eDEGenes_age[eDEGenes_age$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, ]
```

## Overlap to known ageing genes

Now, we are interested in how many of the differentially expressed age genes are overlapping to a database of known ageing genes for human. Therefore, we use the ageing gene database called GenAge and download all human age related genes from their website: https://genomics.senescence.info/download.html

First, we load the known ageing genes from the GenAge database. 

```{r}
ageing_genes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2019_Human_Ageing_Genomic_Resources/genage_human.csv", select = "symbol", data.table = F)
```

Then, we calculate the overlap to the single age DEGenes from our dataset:

```{r}
# gDEGenes
length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, gDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))

# tDEGenes
length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, tDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))

# eDEGenes
length(intersect(ageing_genes$symbol, eDEGenes_age$`Gene Symbol`))
```

Now, we can also check the significance (p-value) of the overlap from our age DEGenes to the known age genes. Therefore, we first need to generate a contingency table and then run Fisher's exact test:

1. gDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(gDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_gDEGenes_age)`
2. tDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(tDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_tDEGenes_age)`
3. eDEGenes: `r FishersExactTest(eDEGenes_age[, "Gene Symbol"], ageing_genes$symbol, bck_eDEGenes_age)`

## VENN diagram

When, we will generate a VENN diagram for the overlap of found eDEGenes, tDEGenes and eDEGenes for age and save it into a pdf file.  

```{r}
gDEGenes_age <- unique(gDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
tDEGenes_age <- unique(tDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
eDEGenes_age <- unique(eDEGenes_age$`Ensembl Gene ID`)
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.1_VENN_DEGenes_for_age.pdf")
grid.newpage()
overrideTriple=T
draw.triple.venn(area1 = length(gDEGenes_age), area2 = length(tDEGenes_age),                  area3 = length(eDEGenes_age), 
                 n12 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age)), 
                 n23 = length(intersect(tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)), 
                 n13 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age)),
                 euler.d = F, scaled = F, 
                 n123 = length(intersect(gDEGenes_age, intersect(tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age))),  
                 category = c(paste("gDEGenes", length(gDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes_age), sep = "\n"), paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes_age), sep = "\n")), 
                 lty = "blank", fill = c(rgb(red = 255, green = 167, blue = 42, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(red = 66, green = 146, blue = 198, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(red = 158, green = 212, blue = 0, maxColorValue = 255)))
dev.off()
```

After finishing all the analysis, we will delete unnecessary data. 

```{r}
rm(gDEGenes_age, tDEGenes_age, eDEGenes_age, ageing_genes)
```

# FUMA

## Load data

```{r}
# tDEGenes
tDEGenes_fuma <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/2.2.5_FUMA/Trans/FUMA_gene2func31297/gtex_v8_ts_DEG.txt", select = c("Category", "GeneSet", "p", "adjP"))
tDEGenes_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(tDEGenes_fuma$adjP)

# eDEGenes
eDEGenes_fuma <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/2.2.5_FUMA/Exon/FUMA_gene2func31296/gtex_v8_ts_DEG.txt", select = c("Category", "GeneSet", "p", "adjP"))
eDEGenes_fuma <- eDEGenes_fuma[eDEGenes_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
eDEGenes_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(eDEGenes_fuma$adjP)
eDEGenes_fuma <- eDEGenes_fuma[eDEGenes_fuma$Category == "DEG.twoside", ]
eDEGenes_fuma <- eDEGenes_fuma[order(eDEGenes_fuma$GeneSet, decreasing = T), ]

# merge tDEGenes and eDEGenes
tDEGenes_fuma <- tDEGenes_fuma[tDEGenes_fuma$GeneSet %in% eDEGenes_fuma$GeneSet, ]
tDEGenes_fuma$type <- "tDEGenes"
eDEGenes_fuma$type <- "eDEGenes"
fuma <- rbind(tDEGenes_fuma, eDEGenes_fuma)
```

## Barplot

Generate a barplot including the results of the down-regulated tDEGenes and eDEGenes. 

```{r}
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.1_barplot_eDEGenes_FUMA.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
ggplot(eDEGenes_fuma, aes(y = log_adjP, x = reorder(GeneSet, order(GeneSet, decreasing = T)))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylab("-log10(adjP)") +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle("eDEGenes") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01)) +
    theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 22), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
dev.off()
```

After finishing all analysis, we will delete unnecessary data. 

```{r}
rm(tDEGenes_fuma, eDEGenes_fuma, fuma)
```


# Gene set (Pathway) enrichment analysis

## Load data

First, we will read in the tDEGenes and eDEGenes for diagnosis. 

```{r}
# tDEGenes 
tDEGenes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_transcripts_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", sep = "\t", select = c("Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)
tDEGenes <- tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, `Gene Symbol`]

# eDEGenes
eDEGenes <- fread("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/1.3_diff_expr_exons_for_diagnosis_new_pvalue_and_fdr.csv", sep = "\t", select = c("Gene Symbol", "FDR estimate"), stringsAsFactors = F)

# save background gene number (all given genes from the dataset)
background_genes <- as.data.frame(eDEGenes[!is.na(eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol`) & eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` != "", ])[, "Gene Symbol"]

# get only significant hits
eDEGenes <- eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`FDR estimate` < 0.1, `Gene Symbol`]
```

## VENN overlap

Before, we perform the GSEA, we will generate a VENN diagram of the overlap of the tDEGenes and eDEGenes. As all six tDEGenes are also eDEGene hits, the VENN diagram should display a huge circle (2,224 eDEGenes) with a smaller circle (6 tDEGenes) inside. 

```{r}
pdf("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_VENN_tDEGenes_eDEGenes_overlap.pdf")
grid.newpage()
draw.pairwise.venn(area1 = length(tDEGenes), area2 = length(eDEGenes), cross.area = length(intersect(tDEGenes, eDEGenes)), fill = c(rgb(red = 66, green = 146, blue = 198, maxColorValue = 255), rgb(red = 158, green = 212, blue = 0, maxColorValue = 255)), category = c(paste("tDEGenes", length(tDEGenes), sep = "\n"), paste("eDEGenes", length(eDEGenes), sep = "\n")), lty = "blank", cex = 2)
dev.off()
```

## Load MSigDB

For the gene set enrichment, sometimes also called pathway enrichment, we will use the sub-collection of "Canonical pathways" from the "C2: curated gene sets" and the "c5: gene ontology (GO) gene sets" of the Molecular Signature DataBase (MSigDB) downloaded from the GSEA website: http://software.broadinstitute.org/gsea/downloads.jsp

We load the data as Gene Set Collections (multiple Gene Sets), where the gene set (pathway) name is the key and all included genes (symbols) of the gene set are stored in a list (value). It is similar to a dictionary in python or a hashmap in Java with a key (gene set name) and value (list of included genes) pair.

```{r}
# load MSigDB c2 - canonical pathways
all_canonical <- getGmt("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_MSigDB/msigdb_v7.0_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v7.0_GMTs/c2.cp.v7.0.symbols.gmt", 
                  collectionType = BroadCollection(category = "c2"),  
                  geneIdType = SymbolIdentifier())
# load MSigDB c5 - gene ontology (GO) 
all_go <- getGmt("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2020_MSigDB/msigdb_v7.0_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v7.0_GMTs/c5.all.v7.0.symbols.gmt", 
                  collectionType = BroadCollection(category = "c5"),  
                  geneIdType = SymbolIdentifier())
```

**TODO:** As the gene symbols are not as sufficient as Ensembl Gene IDs, we will map the gene symbols to Ensembl IDs using the latest GENCODE file created on GRCh37 (hg19) release 19 (downloaded from: https://www.gencodegenes.org/human/release_19.html). 

## Gene set (Pathway) enrichment analysis

Now, we use the MGSA tool to find pathways which are enriched for our dataset.

### MSigDB - Canonical Pathways

```{r}
cp_mgsa <- list()
for (gset in all_canonical) {
  t <- list(gset@geneIds)
 cp_mgsa <- c(cp_mgsa, t)
}
names(cp_mgsa) <- names(all_canonical)
set.seed(0)  # necessary to get the same results all the time!!
cp_res <- mgsa(o = as.character(eDEGenes[!is.na(eDEGenes)]), sets = cp_mgsa, population = as.character(background_genes))
plot(cp_res)
dev.off()

mgsa_res_cp <- setsResults(cp_res)
head(mgsa_res_cp[order(mgsa_res_cp$estimate, decreasing = T),])
write.table(mgsa_res_cp, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/3_GSEA_MGSA_MSigDB_c2_canonical_pathways_results.tsv")

# save only the significant pathways (score > 0.5)
mgsa_res_cp <- mgsa_res_cp[mgsa_res_cp$estimate > 0.5, ]
mgsa_res_cp <- mgsa_res_cp[!(row.names(mgsa_res_cp) == "NA"), ]
plot_mgsa_cp <- as.data.frame(mgsa_res_cp[order(mgsa_res_cp$estimate, decreasing = T), ])
## set the levels in order we want
bp <- ggplot(data = plot_mgsa_cp, aes(x = reorder(row.names(plot_mgsa_cp), estimate), y = estimate)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + xlab("") + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() + ggtitle("MsigDB: c2 - cp")
bp + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
ggsave("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.1_barplot_eDEGenes_MSigDB_top10_enriched_c2_canonical_pathways.pdf", width = 5, height = 2)
```

### MSigDB - GO gene sets

```{r}
go_mgsa <- list()
for (gset in all_go) {
  t <- list(gset@geneIds)
 go_mgsa <- c(go_mgsa, t)
}
names(go_mgsa) <- names(all_go)
set.seed(0)  # necessary to get the same results all the time!!
go_res <- mgsa(o = as.character(eDEGenes[!is.na(eDEGenes)]), sets = go_mgsa, population = as.character(background_genes))
plot(go_res)

mgsa_res_go <- setsResults(go_res)
head(mgsa_res_go[order(mgsa_res_go$estimate, decreasing = T),])
write.table(mgsa_res_go, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/03_results/3_GSEA_MGSA_MSigDB_c5_all_GO_gene_sets_results.tsv")

# save only the 10 pathways with the highest estimate
plot_mgsa_go <- as.data.frame(head(mgsa_res_go[order(mgsa_res_go$estimate, decreasing = T), ], 10))
## set the levels in order we want
bp <- ggplot(data = plot_mgsa_go, aes(x = reorder(row.names(plot_mgsa_go), estimate), y = estimate)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + xlab("") + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() + ggtitle("MsigDB: c5 - GO")
```

# Transcripts per Gene

Now, we will plot the distribution of Ensembl Transcript IDs per Ensembl Gene ID. We will plot the distribution in our filtered expression dataset as well as the original transcripts per gene found in GENCODE (for hg19). 

```{r, echo = F}
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/01_RData_Files/7_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_probeset_summaries_filtered_batch_corrected_SVA_transcript_summaries_annotated.RData")
features <- fData(transcript_summaries)[, c("transcript_id", "gene_id")]
features <- separate_rows(features, transcript_id, gene_id, sep = "\\|")
features <- features[!duplicated(features), ]
freqs <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(features$gene_id))$Freq))

# load gene to transcript info from Gencode and filter exactly like in the preprocessing step
genes <- import.gff("/storage/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/annotation_files/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", format = "gtf")
genes <- genes[genes$gene_type == "protein_coding"]  
genes <- genes[genes$type == "transcript"]
genes <- genes[genes$source == "HAVANA"]
genes <- as.data.frame(genes)[, c("gene_id", "transcript_id")]

# get only Ensembl gene IDs for which we have transcripts (see above)
genes <- genes[genes$gene_id %in% features$gene_id, ]
genes <- genes[!duplicated(genes), ]
freqs2 <- as.data.frame(table(as.data.frame(table(genes$gene_id))$Freq))

# merge the two datasets
tfreq <- merge(freqs, freqs2, by = "Var1", all = T)
tfreq[is.na(tfreq$Freq.x), "Freq.x"] <- 0
tfreq[is.na(tfreq$Freq.y), "Freq.y"] <- 0
colnames(tfreq) <- c("TranscriptCount", "ExpressionFreq", "OriginalFreq")
tfreq <- reshape2::melt(tfreq, id.vars = "TranscriptCount")
tfreq$TranscriptCount <- as.numeric(tfreq$TranscriptCount)

ggplot(tfreq, aes(x = TranscriptCount, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9), legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"), legend.title = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.015, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = "# transcripts per gene", y = "# genes") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridis(2, begin = 0.3, end = 0.9, option = "D"), labels = c("Own data", "GENCODE"))  
ggsave("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/04.DEA/04_figures/1.3_plot_transcripts_per_gene_gencode_vs_own_data.pdf")
rm(features, genes, freqs, freqs2, tfreq)
```
